notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Jyoti.
description:
Activate Jyoti by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Jyoti enters, it and Deadeye Navigator trigger.
Resolve the Jyoti trigger, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature token for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game
When the Forest Dryads enter, Tatyova triggers that many times, giving them haste until end of turn.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Jyoti.
Activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
